description:
Permanently delete one of your own comments or replies. Deleting a top-level comment deletes its replies.

Others' comments on your videos can't be deleted, only rejected, which hides them.
Without confirm, nothing is deleted and the error describes the comment.

Quota: 52 units.

confirm.description: The comment ID again, passed only after the user has approved deleting this comment.

my_channel.description: Which of your logged-in channels to work on: UC… ID or @handle. Omit for the default channel.

already_gone.description: Nothing to delete: it didn't exist or was already deleted.
